arxiv-2104-05564.title: Graphene-based autonomous pyroelectric system for near-field energy conversion
arxiv-2104-05564.creator: I. Latella 1 and P. Ben-Abdallah 2
arxiv-2104-05564.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by I. Latella 1 and P. Ben-Abdallah 2. In the close vicinity of a hot solid, at distances smaller than the thermal wavelength, a strong electromagnetic energy density exists [ 1 ] because of the presence of evanescent field. Here we explore the possibility to harvest this energy using graphene-based pyroelectric conversion devices made with an active layer encapsulated between two graphene field-effect transistors [ 2 ] (GFETs) deposited on the source and on the cold sink.

arxiv-2112-11546.title: Model Sketching by Abstraction Refinement for Lifted Model Checking (Extended Version) Conference: The 37th ACM/SIGAPP Symposium on Applied Computing; April 25–29, 2022; Virtual Event, DOI: 10.1145/3477314.3507170 Note: This is an extended version of the paper that was published at The 37th ACM/SIGA
arxiv-2112-11546.creator: Aleksandar S. Dimovski
arxiv-2112-11546.description: Abstract . In this work, we show how the use of verification and analysis techniques for model families (software product lines) with numerical features provides an interesting technique to synthesize complete models from sketches (i.e. partial models with holes). In particular, we present an approach for synthesizing Promela model sketches using variability-specific abstraction refinement for lifted (family-based) model checking .

arxiv-2207-12454.title: The “SPectrogram Analysis and Cataloguing Environment” (SPACE) Labelling Tool
arxiv-2207-12454.creator: C. K. Louis 1,∗ , C. M. Jackman 1 , S. W. Mangham 2 , K. D. Smith 1 , E. P. O’Dwyer 1 , A. Empey 1 , B. Cecconi 3 , P. Zarka 3 , S. Maloney 1
arxiv-2207-12454.description: Abstract The SPectrogram Analysis and Cataloguing Environment (SPACE) tool is an interactive python tool designed to label radio emission features of interest in a time-frequency map (called “dynamic spectrum”). The program uses Matplotlib’s Polygon Selector widget to allow a user to select and edit an undefined number of vertices on top of the dynamic spectrum before closing the shape (polygon).

arxiv-2309-16075.title: A review of variable-pitch propellers and their control strategies in aerospace systems
arxiv-2309-16075.creator: Hanjie Jiang, Ye Zhou, Hann Woei Ho
arxiv-2309-16075.description: Abstract The relentless pursuit of aircraft flight efficiency has thrust variable-pitch propeller technology into the forefront of aviation innovation. This technology, rooted in the ancient power unit of propellers, has found renewed significance, particularly in the realms of unmanned aerial vehicles and urban air mobility. This underscores the profound interplay between visionary aviation concepts and the enduring utility of propellers.

arxiv-2403-05492.title: The Strong Lefschetz Property of Gorenstein Algebras Generated by Relative Invariants
arxiv-2403-05492.creator: Takahiro Nagaoka, Akihito Wachi
arxiv-2403-05492.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Takahiro Nagaoka, Akihito Wachi. We prove the strong Lefschetz property for Artinian Gorenstein algebras generated by the relative invariants of prehomogeneous vector spaces of commutative parabolic type. 2020 Mathematics Subject Classification 13E10, 11S90, 17B10 1. Introduction Let Q=k[x_{1},x_{2},\ldots,x_{n}] be a polynomial ring over a field k of characteristic zero, and R=k[\partial/\partial x_{1},\partial/\partial x_{2},\ldots,\partial/\partial x_{n}] the ring of partial differential operators with constant coefficients. Set \Ann_{R}(F)=\{P\in R\mid P(F)=0\} for F\in Q . Then R/\Ann_{R}(F) is a graded Artinian Gorenstein algebra.

arxiv-2407-13420.title: Exploring End-to-end Differentiable Neural Charged Particle Tracking – A Loss Landscape Perspective
arxiv-2407-13420.creator: Tobias Kortus tobias.kortus@rptu.de, Ralf Keidel ralf.keidel@rptu.de, Nicolas R. Gauger nicolas.gauger@scicomp.uni-kl.de, On behalf of the Bergen pCT Collaboration
arxiv-2407-13420.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Tobias Kortus tobias.kortus@rptu.de, Ralf Keidel ralf.keidel@rptu.de, Nicolas R. Gauger nicolas.gauger@scicomp.uni-kl.de, On behalf of the Bergen pCT Collaboration. Measurement and analysis of high energetic particles for scientific, medical or industrial applications is a complex procedure, requiring the design of sophisticated detector and data processing systems. The development of adaptive and differentiable software pipelines using a combination of conventional and machine learning algorithms is therefore getting ever more important to optimize and operate the system efficiently while maintaining end-to-end (E2E) differentiability.

arxiv-2412-20262.title: Modular operads, iterated distributive laws and a nerve theorem for circuit algebras Thanks: The author acknowledges the support of Australian Research Council grants DP160101519 and FT160100393.
arxiv-2412-20262.creator: Sophie Raynor
arxiv-2412-20262.description: Abstract . Circuit algebras are a symmetric version of Jones’s planar algebras. They originated in quantum topology as a framework for encoding virtual crossings. This paper extends existing results for modular operads to construct a graphical calculus and monad for general circuit algebras and prove an abstract nerve theorem.

arxiv-2502-11189.title: Szekeres Universes with GUP corrections
arxiv-2502-11189.creator: Andronikos Paliathanasis
arxiv-2502-11189.description: Abstract We demonstrate that introducing a deformed algebra with a minimum length modifies the field equations for an inhomogeneous spacetime, resulting in the emergence of acceleration. Specifically, we examine the analytic effects of the Generalized Uncertainty Principle on the classical field equations of the Szekeres system.

arxiv-2505-19397.title: Are Time-Series Foundation Models Deployment-Ready? A Systematic Study of Adversarial Robustness Across Domains
arxiv-2505-19397.creator: Jiawen ZhangHKUST (GZ)Guangzhou, China, Zhenwei Zhang Tsinghua UniversityBeijing, China, Shun ZhengMicrosoft Research AsiaBeijing, China, Xumeng WenMicrosoft Research AsiaBeijing, China, Jia LiHKUST (GZ)Guangzhou, China, Jiang BianMicrosoft Research AsiaBeijing, China
arxiv-2505-19397.description: Abstract Time-Series Foundation Models (TSFMs) are rapidly transitioning from research prototypes to core components of critical decision-making systems, driven by their impressive zero-shot forecasting capabilities. However, as their deployment surges, a critical blind spot remains: their fragility under adversarial attacks. This lack of scrutiny poses severe risks, particularly as TSFMs enter high-stakes environments vulnerable to manipulation.

arxiv-2602-08096.title: GAAVI: Global Asymptotic Anytime Valid Inference for the Conditional Mean Function
arxiv-2602-08096.creator: Brian M Cho, Raaz Dwivedi, Nathan Kallus
arxiv-2602-08096.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Brian M Cho, Raaz Dwivedi, Nathan Kallus. Inference on the conditional mean function (CMF) is central to tasks from adaptive experimentation to optimal treatment assignment and algorithmic fairness auditing. In this work, we provide a novel asymptotic anytime-valid test for a CMF global null (e.g., that all conditional means are zero) and contrasts between CMFs, enabling experimenters to make high confidence decisions at any time during the experiment beyond a minimum sample size.
